# Use a saved page

The user saves pages to `saved-pages/<PageClass>/` (saved-pages/README.md). To use one:

1. **Which class?** The folder says. If it is `NEW-...` or the page fits no class (compare its
   URL, title and headings with the page classes' Javadoc), see add-a-page-type.md.
2. **Find the element** the story needs: search the HTML for its visible text. Look at its tag
   and attributes, and at its parents for a stable id or test id.
3. **Write the locator** (add-an-element.md) and check it matches exactly one visible element in
   the saved HTML. If you can, open the file in a browser and try it:
   `document.evaluate("//button[...]", document, null, 7, null).snapshotLength` for XPath, or
   `document.querySelectorAll("...").length` for CSS.
4. **Compare with the crawl** when a generated locator stopped working: crawl/playwright-playground.com.crawl.json
   has what each page showed when the suite was generated (search it for the page's URL).

Never copy personal data from a saved page into code: names, emails, addresses, order numbers.
Use made-up values of the same shape (`pat@example.com`).
